label: lem:topological-mass-transient-localisation
title: Transient terms localise to exceptional divisors
html:
Lemma. Transient terms localise to exceptional divisors

The transient component \alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) operates exclusively on disjoint discs D_i centred at the blow-up points p_1, \ldots, p_N. The norm of its multiplicative integral reduces to a sum over the exceptional divisors E_i:

  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma
  \bigl(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)\bigr)
  \bigr\rVert
  =
  \sum_{i=1}^{N}
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_{E_i}
  \bigl(\nabla_A q, L \wedge F^+\bigr)
  \bigr\rVert.
